title: Business Capability Model
description: Visual map of the Business Capabilities Catalogue (BUS-CAP), arranged as a nested card diagram: Level 1 capabilities as groups, Level 2 capabilities as items within each group, and optionally Level 3 capabilities nested within each Level 2 item. The overview renders Levels 1-2 on one slide; when Level 3 data is present, a drill-down diagram per Level 1 capability follows, showing its Level 2 cards with their Level 3 capabilities inside. Derived from BUS-CAP rather than authored directly.

meta.description: A visual map of the organisation's capabilities, arranged as a nested hierarchy.
purpose: Give a single-page view of the capability landscape for workshops and roadmap discussions.
Highlight which capabilities are strategic, differentiating, or foundational at a glance.
Drill into each Level 1 capability to see its Level 2 and Level 3 breakdown.
Provide an embeddable diagram for presentations, kept in sync with BUS-CAP.
